deals.postCaption: Best way to spend a birthday: getting things for free!!🎂💸✨ Went all over Vienna and had the best time! If you want to enjoy your special day, don't miss out on these cool opportunities! -Get entry free and to ride the slide for free at Donauturm🗼 -Eat for free at all you can eat buffet at Watertuin restaurant🍽️ -Free entry at Madame Tussauds🤳 -Eat for free up to 15€ worth at Cafe Latte (but bring a friend!) ☕ -Free entry at Römertherme in Baden (just 1h away by train from Vienna) 🚉 If you know any other free things you can get and do on your birthday in Vienna drop it in the comments!!💖 . . #birthday #freethings #freebirthday #viennacity #thingstodoinvienna
